I am 72 years old and I never went to school. For this small bean plot, I will plant the seeds I kept from last year because buying new ones costs money I do not have, and I will not waste chemical fertilizer on beans when my maize plot needs it more. I will put a few baskets of manure from my goats on the plot because manure is free and makes the soil soft. My children will help me pull weeds and harvest, so I do not need to hire anyone or buy chemicals.
